testcase.name: Scenario: List active Tools panels from an inactive tab menu: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:705:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: List active Tools panels from an inactive tab menu ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full Tools ribbon is active ✔ When the user right-clicks the inactive 3D Model tab ✔ Then the Tools ribbon remains active ✔ And the ribbon context menu is visible ✔ When the user opens Show Panels from that menu ✔ Then the submenu lists Measure, Material and Appearance, Options, Clipboard, Find, Team Web and Tutorials ✔ And each listed Tools panel is checked ✔ And the 3D Model tab remains inactive
